description: This script provides functions for managing firmware upgrades on Glinet devices, specifically handling NAND and NOR flash memory upgrade procedures and setting the next boot configuration.

methods.name: glinet_using_boot_dev_switch
methods.description: Checks if the device is configured to switch boot device based on environment variable.

methods.name: glinet_set_next_boot_nand
methods.description: Sets up the environment to boot from NAND on the next restart.

methods.name: glinet_set_next_boot_nor
methods.description: Sets up the environment to boot from NOR on the next restart.

methods.name: glinet_nand_nor_do_upgrade
methods.description: Determines whether to perform NAND or NOR upgrade based on the image magic, then calls the appropriate upgrade function.

methods.name: nand_nor_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the logic to upgrade firmware either in NAND or NOR, depending on the image magic value.
